title: requires_snapshot answer of GET /v1/updates/{from_revision}
description: Returned (200, application/json) when no update package from from_revision to the current revision. Client takes snapshot path with GET /v1/snapshots/{snapshot_revision}, verified against that revision's manifest.

reason.description: below_minimum: from_revision < minimum_revision (includes 0 and snapshot-only releases). package_missing: the package object is absent although from_revision >= minimum_revision.
